Opinions on smaller or specialized firms (such as rideshare accident specialists like Legal Rideshare or local practices) vary among community discussions on platforms like Reddit, where local users note that the best fit depends heavily on communication style and whether a firm actually takes cases to trial. Reddit·r/AskChicago
Contingency Fee: Most personal injury lawyers in Illinois work on contingency (typically ~33% to 40%), meaning no upfront fees and you pay nothing unless they recover money for you. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers +2
Statute of Limitations: Illinois generally enforces a two-year deadline from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit (735 ILCS 5/13-202). Briskman Briskman & Greenberg +1
Comparative Fault: Illinois uses a modified comparative fault rule (50% bar rule), meaning you can recover compensation as long as you are 50% or less at fault, though your payout is reduced by your percentage of fault. Malman Law +1
